messages:
laura_ops: Quick sync for IsleAnalytics private rollout — go-live window is still Wed 10:00 UTC. Any network or image gating this morning? 

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary deploy queued for 2026-05-12T10:00:00Z (ID: canary-isl-71). See /deploys/canary.

samir_net: @laura_ops seeing one blocker: IsleCorp's security team hasn't approved egress to our public registry (ghcr.redwood-inference:443). They only allow allowlisted registries. Customer asked for a registry mirror + signed images. 

ben_eng: Do we have a mirror flow ready? If not, I can wire up a temporary registry in their VPC but need certs and a push token. Also runtime needs the kernel option `vm.max_map_count=262144` on the host — ops to confirm.

marta_platform: Ownership: platform team (marta_platform) owns the mirror tooling and the mirror-script PR (#423). infra/ops (laura_ops + samir_net) own cert install and firewall changes. I'll pick up PR review today.

samir_net: Firewall specifics from customer: allowed outbound ranges: `203.0.113.0/24` and `198.51.100.128/25`. Ports: 443 to mirrors, 123 (NTP), and 22 for staging jumps. Suggested customer rule snippet:
```
# Example Palo Alto policy
source: vpc-island
destination: 203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.128/25
services: application-https, ntp
action: allow
```
They also need TLS inspection off for registry endpoints.

laura_ops: Noted. I'll ask IsleCorp to add those ranges by EOD. For certs: do we have an automated S3 pull for signed image bundles? If not, we'll do a one-off scp.

ben_eng: Mirror script currently supports `--signed` and `--bundle` flags. Usage:
`./mirror.sh --src ghcr.redwood-inference --dst isle-registry.local --signed`
I'll add instructions to PR. @marta_platform can you confirm the tag signing key location?

marta_platform: Key is in vault path `secret/isle/registry-signing`. I'll include steps in PR and drop reviewer notes. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/mirror-tool/pull/423

cli-qa: Quick QA ask: who runs the smoke after canary? I can do an initial token-generation & embedding smoke. Need access to the canary creds.

laura_ops: @cli-qa you'll get temporary creds. Samir, can you enable a NAT rule to allow image pushes from our staging NAT IP (34.82.11.9)?

samir_net: Enabled for a 4-hour window starting 1765432800 (UTC ts). I'll post confirmation once customer updates firewall. 

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (canary-isl-71) — logs: /canary/isl-71/logs

laura_ops: Summary / action items:
- samir_net: confirm firewall entries & NAT window (ETA: +2h)
- laura_ops: send cert install steps & temporary scp plan to IsleCorp (ETA: 3h)
- marta_platform: merge PR #423 and add signing docs (ETA: EOD)
- ben_eng: add `vm.max_map_count` note to onprem-host doc (ETA: next 2h)
- cli-qa: run smoke after canary starts and post results here (ETA: ~+30m after canary)

Any objections or missing owners? :eyes:
